# David Shumba

David Shumba is a UK-based Data Apprentice at Mercedes-Benz Financial Services, studying BSc (Hons) Digital and Technology Solutions at Cranfield University (Level 6 degree apprenticeship, Software Engineering specialism).

## What he does

He works across data engineering, financial reconciliation and analytics: Azure Data Factory pipelines that automate finance data delivery, reconciliation automation in Python and SQL, and Power BI reporting for Finance and Audit. Previously a Data Analyst Degree Apprentice at apetito UK.

## Current focus

Building software engineering foundations (testing, APIs, CI/CD) through shipped projects, with an interest in healthcare and automotive problems. Currently building:
- NHS A&E Performance Pipeline: a tested data pipeline for NHS England's monthly A&E data (Python, DuckDB, SQL, pytest, GitHub Actions). https://github.com/davidshumba/nhs-ae-pipeline

## Skills

Python, SQL, PySpark, DAX, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, pandas, Power BI, Excel, Git, GitHub, pytest, VS Code, Vercel.
